reviewed_by: Claude; selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent; the resume race root cause independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: Product: SubagentService._resume_waiting_turn (chat_subagents.py) checked has_active_provider_turn, then awaited prepare_resume before start_provider_turn, so two subagent deliveries finishing together could both pass the check: both started a continuation, or the loser's ChatHistoryConflict reached _fail_unresumable, whose guard reads the turn row before the winner's claim is written, and failed the parent and paused its goal. A per-turn in-flight resume set makes check-and-start atomic within the process, and a ChatHistoryConflict is treated as a lost race only when fresh execution state (a local runtime or a claim on the turn row) shows a continuation owns the turn. Tests: the new race file forces both deliveries together and a competing start between check and start (both fail on origin/main), plus an unresumable parent that still fails visibly; neighbouring delivery, recovery, outcome-note, throughput and subagent suites cover the unchanged paths.
exclusions: test_chat_subagent_lifecycle.py passed locally (20) but is not selected: its process sometimes hangs at exit on unclosed aiosqlite threads. No UI, frontend, native or Playwright surface changed. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
